title: MutexaGPT: an intuition-to-design translator for physics-based enzyme engineering
methods: Agentic workflows; Molecular simulation; Structure-based design
summary: Translates qualitative engineering ideas into physics-based calculations and variant selection, with retrospective methyltransferase analysis and prospective amylase experiments.

title: Computational enzyme design by catalytic motif scaffolding
methods: Structure-based design; Generative models; Machine learning
summary: Combines catalytic motif placement, diffusion and atomistic modelling in Riff-Diff, with experimental evaluation of retro-aldol and Morita–Baylis–Hillman catalysts.

title: Computational design of metallohydrolases
summary: Uses generative scaffolding and active-site ensemble evaluation to construct zinc-dependent hydrolases, followed by experimental characterization of selected designs.

title: Complete computational design of high-efficiency Kemp elimination enzymes
summary: Constructs and computationally optimizes Kemp eliminases, testing whether designed active sites can achieve efficient catalysis without extensive experimental library screening.

title: Active learning-assisted directed evolution
methods: Active learning; Machine learning; Directed evolution
summary: Combines uncertainty-aware model selection with iterative experiments to navigate combinatorial enzyme variants during a directed-evolution campaign.

title: Computational design of serine hydrolases
summary: Combines generative backbone construction and active-site ensemble assessment to design serine hydrolases and evaluate their catalytic activity experimentally.

title: Self-driving laboratories to autonomously navigate the protein fitness landscape
methods: Active learning; Machine learning; Experimental screening
summary: Connects automated experiments with data-driven selection in a self-driving laboratory, using enzyme thermal tolerance as a protein-engineering objective.

title: The use of proton transfer reaction mass spectrometry for high throughput screening of terpene synthases
summary: Evaluates proton-transfer-reaction mass spectrometry as a rapid screening readout for terpene synthases and their engineered variants.

title: Enzyme function prediction using contrastive learning
summary: Introduces CLEAN for contrastive-learning-based enzyme function prediction, combining computational benchmarks with experimental demonstrations on selected enzymes.

title: De novo design of luciferases using deep learning
methods: Generative models; Structure-based design; Machine learning
summary: Uses deep-learning-based scaffold generation and active-site design to produce luciferases, followed by biochemical testing of light-producing catalysis.

title: Large language models generate functional protein sequences across diverse families
summary: Uses a conditional protein language model to generate sequences, with experimental lysozyme testing demonstrating catalytic function in a subset of generated proteins.

title: Machine learning-aided engineering of hydrolases for PET depolymerization
methods: Machine learning; Structure-based design; Experimental screening
summary: Uses structure-informed machine learning to propose PET hydrolase variants, then measures enzyme stability and plastic depolymerization performance.

title: Low-N protein engineering with data-efficient deep learning
summary: Combines pretrained protein representations with small experimental datasets to guide sequence optimization, including an enzyme engineering demonstration.

title: Integrating structure-based machine learning and co-evolution to investigate specificity in plant sesquiterpene synthases
methods: Machine learning; Bioinformatics / genome mining; Structure-based design
summary: Combines structural features and co-evolution to investigate sesquiterpene synthase pathway specificity, with experimental characterization of selected predictions.

title: An ultrahigh-throughput screening platform based on flow cytometric droplet sorting for mining novel enzymes from metagenomic libraries
summary: Uses droplet compartments and flow-cytometric sorting to functionally screen metagenomic libraries and identify previously uncharacterized esterases.

title: Discovery and engineering of colchicine alkaloid biosynthesis
summary: Combines pathway-guided enzyme discovery and biochemical reconstruction to assign functions in plant alkaloid biosynthesis, including an unusual oxidative transformation.

title: An engineered PET depolymerase to break down and recycle plastic bottles
summary: Engineers a PET-degrading hydrolase and evaluates enzymatic depolymerization in a plastic-recycling context, linking enzyme properties to process performance.

title: The santalene synthase from Cinnamomum camphora: Reconstruction of a sesquiterpene synthase from a monoterpene synthase
summary: Investigates related terpene synthases and reconstructed variants to connect sequence changes with monoterpene versus sesquiterpene catalytic behavior.

title: Machine-learning-guided directed evolution for protein engineering
methods: Machine learning; Directed evolution; Active learning
summary: Reviews how machine learning can guide directed evolution, emphasizing sequence–function modelling and the choice of variants for experimental evaluation.

title: Ultrahigh-throughput discovery of promiscuous enzymes by picodroplet functional metagenomics
summary: Screens metagenomic libraries in microfluidic droplets to discover catalytic activities that are difficult to infer from sequence similarity alone.

title: Enzyme Function Initiative-Enzyme Similarity Tool (EFI-EST): A web tool for generating protein sequence similarity networks
summary: Provides sequence-similarity-network generation to organize enzyme families and support the prioritization of proteins for functional characterization.

title: Navigating the protein fitness landscape with Gaussian processes
methods: Machine learning; Active learning; Structure-based design
summary: Uses Gaussian-process models to guide exploration of protein fitness landscapes and experimentally evaluate selected cytochrome P450 chimeras.

title: Biocatalytic asymmetric synthesis of chiral amines from ketones applied to sitagliptin manufacture
methods: Directed evolution; Structure-based design; Experimental screening
summary: Combines enzyme redesign and directed evolution to develop a transaminase suited to an industrial asymmetric synthesis application.

title: Kemp elimination catalysts by computational enzyme design
summary: Places designed catalytic sites into protein scaffolds, experimentally tests Kemp elimination, and improves selected catalysts through directed evolution.

title: De novo computational design of retro-aldol enzymes
summary: Constructs alternative catalytic motifs in protein scaffolds and tests retro-aldol activity, using structural characterization to examine design accuracy.

title: Tuning the activity of an enzyme for unusual environments: sequential random mutagenesis of subtilisin E for catalysis in dimethylformamide
summary: Uses sequential mutagenesis and screening to adapt subtilisin activity to an unusual solvent environment, providing an early directed-evolution example.
